name: Armored Queen
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: dedicated static creature sprite for Alien Tantalus Frontier.
Input image 1 is the existing base identity AND rendering-style reference only. If it contains multiple animation frames, use them to understand the SAME single subject, never reproduce the grid.
Create ONE new full-body standing/ready static pose of Armored Queen. This is an original systemic project variant, not a canon-exact claim.
Anatomy and identity: Xenomorph Queen as pictured: tall upright digitigrade Queen with exactly TWO large legs, TWO long main arms and TWO smaller secondary arms tucked at chest (four arms total), ribbed narrow waist, huge backwards-swept fan-shaped ridged cranial crown, eyeless snarling mouth under crown, back spines, and ONE long segmented tail with blade tip. Preserve regal high silhouette and reference blue-black biomechanical morphology. Natural overlapping dark carapace reinforces crown/shoulders/thighs without mechanical armor or changing limb count.
Variant lock: Original systemic armored variant: preserve exact base anatomy, equipment and silhouette family, add practical layered protection consistent with the base. Organic creatures have dark natural carapace plates, not mechanical suits; people retain recognizable uniform and equipment with additional guards. No extra appendages or new weapons.
Style: match the source's detailed textured realistic painted game-sprite rendering, anatomically legible silhouette, controlled highlights and dark contours, not cartoon or chibi. Preserve identifying shape and appendage counts.
Composition: exactly ONE subject, fully visible, head/front facing RIGHT, slightly elevated side/three-quarter 2D-game view, neutral alert stance. All appendages, tail tips and feet included. At least 10% empty transparent padding on every side. Grounded extremities share an imaginary ground plane, no drawn floor.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA. No backdrop, scenery, cast shadow blob or checkerboard painted into pixels.
Avoid: grid, contact sheet, duplicate bodies, panels, text, numbers, logos, watermark, gore, blood, wounds, extra limbs, new weapons, mechanical suits, cropping. Only the single intact requested subject.
